headline: Back on the bike after 11 days — now rebuild the climb
body:
That 15.7 miles with 419 feet breaks an eleven-day gap, and that's worth something, but be honest about what it adds: a flat-ish hour that maintains neither axis. On distance, your longest ride is 27.7 miles — less than half of 62 — and weekly volume has fallen from 68.8 miles to 8.1 to 15.7. On climbing, your biggest day is 1,819 feet; Gibraltar alone is 2,551, and the route asks 6,600. Both axes are behind with 22 days left. The single most useful thing now is climbing feet on tired legs: foothill repeats after 25–30 flat miles.

Ride Saturday long — 78°F, light wind — and push past 30 miles. Sunday, add foothill work. Monday is 84°F with 22 mph gusts: short spin or rest. Tuesday at 85 wants an early start or a day off. Wednesday and Thursday are calm and mild — make one of them your biggest climbing day yet.
